goal: Allow RPC consumers to optionally receive feerates formatted in sat/vB instead of BTC/kvB
Eliminate manual unit conversions and potential calculation errors in modern tooling
reviewability: Ready to review; the branch is clean, CI passes, and prior reviewer feedback has been addressed
agreement: Broad support for standardizing feerate outputs to modern sat/vB conventions (w0xlt, musaHaruna, jonatack)
Discussed returning distinct fields instead of an argument to avoid configuration hazards (glozow)
Concerns about floating-point math, bucket ranges, and parameter naming were resolved (maflcko, w0xlt, jonatack)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it offers a long-requested usability convenience for RPC consumers working in sat/vB
It is an opt-in parameter on existing RPCs rather than a bug fix or architectural prerequisite
